control_name: ICFR control matrix is complete and key controls are tested
control_objective: The ICFR control matrix is complete with a named owner for every key control, all key controls are tested within the assessment cycle, and identified deficiencies are remediated, supporting management's §404 assessment of internal control over financial reporting.
risk_addressed: An incomplete control matrix, untested key controls, or unremediated deficiencies can cause management's §404 assessment to be unsupported, leaving a material weakness undetected and undisclosed.

applies_to: ICFR control matrix and key control testing

required_data_elements.business_definition: A key control in the ICFR control matrix, including its assigned owner.
The documented testing result for a key control in the assessment cycle.
An identified control deficiency and its remediation status.

method.summary: Assess completeness of the ICFR control matrix, confirm every key control has a named owner and has been tested in the cycle, and confirm there are no unremediated deficiencies.
steps: Pull the key control population from the GRC control matrix.
Confirm each key control has a named owner.
Reconcile each key control to a documented test result for the cycle.
Pull the deficiency log and confirm remediation status.
Compute controls without owner, tested percentage, and unremediated deficiency count.
method.fallback_logic: If the control matrix or test workpaper source is unavailable, mark Not Run and raise a Missing Source item rather than passing.

thresholds.materiality_basis: Any key control without an owner is a control exception; untested key controls and unremediated deficiencies are tracked as warnings pending remediation.
thresholds.pass_tolerance: 0 key controls without owner; 100% tested; 0 unremediated deficiencies
thresholds.warning_threshold: Any untested key control or unremediated deficiency
thresholds.escalation_threshold: Any key control without a named owner

pass_criteria: Every key control has a named owner.
All key controls are tested this cycle.
warning_criteria: One or more key controls are not yet tested this cycle.
One or more deficiencies remain unremediated.
fail_criteria: One or more key controls lack a named owner.
The control matrix population cannot be evidenced.
exception_handling: Open a SOX deficiency issue for controls without an owner.
Track untested controls and unremediated deficiencies to completion before §404 assessment sign-off.

assertions.description: Every key control has a named owner.
All key controls tested this cycle.

downstream_linkage.staleness_rule: Must be re-evidenced each quarter before §404 assessment sign-off.

actions_on_fail: Notify SOX Program Manager and CFO
